description: Net operating income (NOI) of a rental property per year: scheduled rent less vacancy, management, maintenance, capital reserve and fixed costs, before any mortgage payment. NOI is easy to overstate: management is charged on rent actually collected, maintenance and reserves on scheduled rent, and the debt payment is left out entirely, so a figure that subtracts the mortgage is cash flow instead. Send the monthly rent for the whole property; vacancy, management, maintenance and capex as percents (8 means 8%); and the yearly fixed costs (tax, insurance, owner-paid utilities, HOA). Any omitted expense counts as 0 and is listed in the answer's inputs.

annual_fixed_costs.description: Property tax, insurance, owner-paid utilities, HOA and other fixed costs per year, e.g. 5400

capex_pct.description: Capital reserve as a percent of scheduled rent, e.g. 5

maintenance_pct.description: Repairs and maintenance as a percent of scheduled rent, e.g. 8

management_pct.description: Property management as a percent of collected rent, e.g. 8

monthly_rent.description: Scheduled rent for the whole property per month, in dollars, e.g. 2400

other_income_monthly.description: Laundry, parking or pet income per month, e.g. 50

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and credit loss as a percent of rent, e.g. 8 for 8%

name: compute_noi
title: Net operating income (NOI)
